Speaker: The Architect
Text: You've made it further than anyone should have. I designed the Nexus to prevent exactly this.

Speaker: Kael
Text: Why? Why would you want to keep the realms apart?

Speaker: The Architect
Text: Because the Rift wasn't random. It was engineered — by Chancellor Draven. He wanted to harness interdimensional energy as a weapon.

Speaker: The Architect
Text: I built the Nexus to contain the damage. But Draven is still out there, still trying to weaponize the Rift.

Speaker: The Architect
Text: If you want to truly save your daughter — and everyone else — Draven must be stopped. I'll help you.
